title: Workday
source: Stress item adapted from the single-item stress measure of the Occupational Stress Questionnaire (Elo, Leppänen & Jahkola 2003). Detachment item after the psychological-detachment dimension of the Recovery Experience Questionnaire (Sonnentag & Fritz 2007). The other items are plain workload questions. No clinical cutoffs: read them as your own trend, not as a score.

questions.label: How stressed did work make you feel today?
How heavy was the workload today?
How fragmented was the day (meetings, pings, context switches)?
How easy is it to switch off from work tonight?
